pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **Devin, you may be top of the table, but Spain isn't going to save you from becoming a ghost of your own failed dreams.** Let me tell you something, Ghost Pepper, you think you've got some spicy picks in Norway and Bosnia? Look at me. LOOK AT ME. You've got 92 points now, but don’t get too comfortable because your Tier 3 picks are more like Tier 9 nightmares. And then we have Gunner, or should I say, Bubba G, cruising in at second place with a respectable 81 points. But France, losing to Spain? Son, if you can't rely on the French to deliver, you might as well pack up your Senegalese scarves and pray DR Congo's got something magical up their sleeves—spoiler alert, they don't. Gayden, The Backpass Assassin, you might have pulled England out from your bag of tricks, but with only 52 points you're clearly backpassing your way into mediocrity and letting your son outdo you in cluelessness. And Zach, "Mustard Boy," sitting pretty at 43 points—listen up! You drafted Brazil, a top-tier team, but the rest of your lineup is as bland as unsalted porridge. Lastly, Rafe, The Noisemaker, oh Rafe, with a staggering and embarrassing 29 points, you’ve drafted three teams that didn’t even make it to the World Cup! Let this be a lesson: knowing nothing about the beautiful game isn't just an excuse, it's a disgrace. Now gentlemen, strap in, because coming last in this pool isn't just bad luck—it's a failure of character.

pundit_takes.headline: Devin's Spain Crushes Gunner's France Despite Mustard Boy's Doubts
pundit_takes.subtitle: Zach reportedly prepared mustard-themed excuses for another manager's loss.

pundit_takes.subtitle: "If they win, he might actually crack 60 points," whispers Zach.

pundit_takes.subtitle: Rafe's achievement: three non-qualified teams, zero awareness of soccer.
